reasons.overall_mobile: Coherent, completable touch-assisted mission with effective route and tap-aim support. First-run coil approach, ammo waste, and dense small text add meaningful friction. Second-run learning helped; the win itself does not establish quality.
reasons.controls: Large persistent touch targets, two-contact route/fire and tap-to-center worked. Turning and maintaining targets while moving needed repeated corrections. Tools requires extra tray actions; capture lifecycle confounds continuous tray usability.
reasons.gameplay: Clear recover/disable/return sequence and exposed-coil cycle provided understandable goals once a clear face was found. First approach became an obstructed search while taking fire. Standing and holding fire worked on second run but spent ammunition in armored windows; depth of evasion is unassessed.
reasons.presentation: Consistent cyan/amber industrial styling, rain, reflective floor, monumental relay and readable terminal hierarchy were effective. Dark geometry sometimes obscured tactical targets. Audio unassessed.
reasons.usability: ROUTE, TURN, planning pause, automatic reload, no-ammo guidance and explicit fresh-start option helped. Route endpoint did not initially make clear where to face or move for coils. Handbook text was partially below the scroll viewport.
reasons.readability: Primary objectives, health and FIRE were readable. Handbook, coil labels/phase hints, compass and terminal secondary statistics were small; top-left boss panel competed with the coil view.
